d.ko: In a Mana-infused land, a dark force led by the enigmatic Shadwyn threatens Neokos. Bring your party of adventurers together across perilous realms in this Turn-Based Tactical RPG based on the SRD 5.2 ruleset. You make the choices, dice decide your destiny.

d.zh: 在这片被魔力浸染的土地上，一股由神秘人莎德温统领的黑暗势力正威胁着尼奥科斯。集结你的冒险小队，准备好在这款基于龙与地下城 SRD 5.2 版本规则的回合制战术角色扮演游戏中征服未知的险境。请记住，选择由你，命运由骰。
